To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we introduce a large scale Minecraft dataset with 60+ million human demonstration examples and that the dataset is challenging and useful for research on reinforcement learning and other machine learning methods.
we have created a dataset of 60 million state action pairs from Minecraft that can be used to train and evaluate reinforcement learning methods.

(1) Minecraft is a challenging domain with many interesting research problems, (2) we introduce a large scale, high quality, simulator paired dataset, MineRL, to facilitate research in Minecraft, (3) we demonstrate the utility of MineRL in a variety of tasks, and (4) we show the potential of Mine RL for future research in the field of reinforcement learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how we can leverage human demonstrations to accelerate the development and deployment of reinforcement learning agents.
the creation of an experimental platform which can be used to develop and evaluate methods which learn from human demonstrations.
the development of methods which require fewer data samples and the construction of a large scale dataset to support the evaluation of such techniques.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

MineRL is a large-scale, simulator paired, dataset of human demonstrations in Minecraft which will facilitate research into the development of more sample efficient deep reinforcement learning algorithms.
we have developed a dataset which is the largest of its kind and is suitable for the development of methods to learn from demonstrations.

MineRL is the first large scale human demonstration dataset for reinforcement learning, and is a key resource to enable the development of methods which leverage demonstrations in complex, real world problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MineRL dataset provides a new, challenging research platform for the development and evaluation of new reinforcement learning methods.
MineRL is an open source dataset of Minecraft demonstrations which will serve as a test bed for the development and evaluation of reinforcement learning methods.
MineRL is a large scale, diverse, and high quality dataset for the reinforcement learning community.
The main takeaway from our work is that
large scale datasets can enable the development and testing of new methods for reinforcement learning.
the MineRL dataset can serve as a benchmark for research in reinforcement learning.
large scale, simulator compatible, human demonstration datasets can enable the development and evaluation of novel techniques for reinforcement learning.
